<function name="GetChatBoxPos" parent="chat" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the chatbox position.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The X coordinate of the chatbox's position.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">The Y coordinate of the chatbox's position.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints the x and y coordinates of the chatbox.</description>
	<code>print( chat.GetChatBoxPos() )</code>

</example>
